title: Registry pointer
description: One published pack version: where its source is, which revision of it, the digest that pins it, and the tier it was published under.

name.description: The pack's own name, as its manifest declares it.

version.description: The pack's own version, as its manifest declares it.

repo.description: Where the pack's source lives. The one reserved value `.` names the repository that hosts this registry.

commit.description: The revision of `repo` the pointer was published against.

path.description: The manifest's path within `repo`, relative and using forward slashes.

sha256.description: The digest of the manifest document, in the form `engine.install.digest` produces.

tier.description: The trust tier the pack was published under.

abandoned.description: Set when the author has stopped maintaining the pack. The store flags it rather than refusing it.
